redesign_reason: the GPU kernel is a CUDA-thread radix-select needing threads/shared-memory atomics/CUDA barriers/dynamic shapes, none of which exist on npuir; the NPU design is two simple kernels (count, select) plus a host-side threshold bisection
architecture_constraints: a kernel holding the compaction plus >=2 unrolled bisection bodies segfaults the build
multi-block GM writes lose rows: T.Kernel(M) dropped half the rows while T.Kernel(1) + a serial row loop was correct, so a single block is used
workload_scale_deviation: the GPU manifest full workload is seq_len=32768 x seq_len_kv=65536 with topk up to 1024; the single-block serial architecture is correct but too slow for that scale, so the manifest workloads are sized to what the delivered kernel runs to completion
